acceptanceCases.title: Inventory and reference build
acceptanceCases.procedure: Record checkout, tracked changes, package/lock versions, instructions and source routes. Execute the existing build unchanged before feature work.
acceptanceCases.expected: Retain exact SHA, command logs, errors and a source/runtime/pending inventory; no inference from screenshots.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: Structure names and reading order
acceptanceCases.procedure: On each editorial and notebook template, traverse headings/regions with a real screen reader; compare DOM and visual order, names, image alternatives and titles.
acceptanceCases.expected: One identifiable main; meaningful names, relations and sequence; no icon-only essential action.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: Global keyboard-only journey
acceptanceCases.procedure: From a fresh page use only Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space and local Escape to read research, follow article/code links, copy a citation and return. Repeat enlarged/narrow.
acceptanceCases.expected: No trap, unexpected navigation or hidden focus. Record the actual focus sequence.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: Mobile menu and consistent navigation
acceptanceCases.procedure: Open and close the navigation disclosure with keyboard and touch; visit another language/template; repeat with enlarged text and little viewport height.
acceptanceCases.expected: Closed links are out of focus order. The nonmodal disclosure does not trap or claim modality.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: Skip to main content
acceptanceCases.procedure: Activate Skip to main content as the first useful keyboard link; continue reading and tabbing in the destination on both generators.
acceptanceCases.expected: Visible skip link moves focus/reading to main, not merely visual scroll; no covered destination.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: Preferences page or dialog
acceptanceCases.procedure: Open the full preference page through its visible link and use all groups, reset and return navigation. A modal is not present.
acceptanceCases.expected: No focus trap; names and groups are clear. If a future modal is added, separately test initial focus, inert background, Escape and focus return.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: Input error and recovery
acceptanceCases.procedure: Submit out-of-range seed/energy, unsupported or corrupted episode file, and a recoverable clipboard failure; inspect persistent labels and corrective messages.
acceptanceCases.expected: No active session is replaced after failed import; entered data remains; errors are textual and connected to the relevant input. No fake contact success.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: Search filters results and history
acceptanceCases.procedure: Search by text and filters, obtain zero results, clear and use browser Back/Forward; repeat with a real screen reader.
acceptanceCases.expected: Focus remains on the initiating control; concise result count; URL keeps search state but no visual preferences. Base list remains without script.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: Rendered palettes and contrast
acceptanceCases.procedure: Run all384 token checks; in /components/ choose each of24 palettes, exercise default/hover/focus/selected/expanded/invalid/disabled states and examine computed colors.
acceptanceCases.expected: Informative text≥4.5 or≥7 in high contrast; functional boundaries≥3 on actual backgrounds. Token results remain separate from rendered evidence.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: Meaning without color discrimination
acceptanceCases.procedure: Use monochrome and supplementary color-deficiency simulation; identify statuses, links, selected controls, errors and data without hue.
acceptanceCases.expected: Meaning survives through words, borders, shape or associated values; scientific images are not globally filtered. Human discrimination is not inferred.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: High contrast
acceptanceCases.procedure: Select high appearance for four profiles and two themes; inspect metadata, code, controls, errors and all informative text.
acceptanceCases.expected: Informative text on actual surfaces≥7:1; profile and theme remain independent. This does not assert global AAA.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: System forced colors
acceptanceCases.procedure: Use both browser emulation and actual Windows forced-color settings in a test profile, operate controls and then restore OS settings.
acceptanceCases.expected: Focus, boundaries and selected states remain recognizable; OS colors prevail without global forced-color-adjust:none. Emulation is not an OS task.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: System and local motion preference
acceptanceCases.procedure: Change system theme/contrast/motion where supported; select explicit site settings; change OS again.
acceptanceCases.expected: Explicit choices are respected except that OS reduced motion always wins; no animated theme change or automatic media.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: Independent visual preferences
acceptanceCases.procedure: Change each preference separately and in combinations, keeping focus on the activated control.
acceptanceCases.expected: No unrelated setting is reset; no reload, scroll-to-top or unexpected context switch.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: Persistence across routes and generators
acceptanceCases.procedure: Set dark/profile/reading, navigate across Astro, Quarto, Spanish and English, then Back/Forward and a second tab.
acceptanceCases.expected: Valid stored preferences survive same-origin navigation. Unsupplied translations are honestly identified.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: Corrupt or denied storage
acceptanceCases.procedure: Deny storage reads/writes, fill storage, insert invalid JSON/unknown values/old supported key and reload in isolated profiles.
acceptanceCases.expected: Safe defaults and validated migration; changes apply in memory; saved is not announced after write failure. Cross-document denial limitations are disclosed.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: Reset and cross-tab preference changes
acceptanceCases.procedure: Set preferences, add an unrelated fixture storage key, reset while focused and synchronize another tab.
acceptanceCases.expected: Only owned keys removed; defaults restored; focus retained; one truthful confirmation and unrelated key preserved.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: Prerecorded video captions and controls
acceptanceCases.procedure: When a real synchronized video is added, check reviewed captions, language/names/formulas, all playback controls and entering/leaving iframe by keyboard.
acceptanceCases.expected: Accurate synchronized captions, accessible operation and no autoplay; current absence of video is inventoried, not a fabricated test.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: Essential visual audio description
acceptanceCases.procedure: For each supplied video compare essential visible information with the spoken narration; examine a described version where needed.
acceptanceCases.expected: Visual information is audibly available for1.2.5. Transcript alone is not a substitute for required audio description.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: Audio-only and silent video alternatives
acceptanceCases.procedure: For audio-only or silent-video records compare the complete source with its faithful structured alternative.
acceptanceCases.expected: Speakers and meaningful sounds/actions are preserved, not a generic summary. Conditional until such records exist.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: Live synchronized media
acceptanceCases.procedure: If live media is introduced, rehearse with the actual captioning service and check keyboard/player/latency under representative conditions.
acceptanceCases.expected: Live captions actually exist; no claim based on a future plan.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: Pause stop hide moving content
acceptanceCases.procedure: Observe all pages without interaction, then operate explicit simulation steps and any future animated media; try pause/stop where relevant.
acceptanceCases.expected: No uncontrolled moving/updating content; informative simulation updates occur only when requested.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: Flashing content
acceptanceCases.procedure: Inspect all generated motion and each future media asset for flashes; use appropriate analysis where relevant.
acceptanceCases.expected: No hazardous decorative flashes; warnings alone do not repair a failing asset. No clinical guarantee is inferred.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: Text and real zoom enlargement
acceptanceCases.procedure: On a real browser use200% text enlargement and200%/400% browser zoom, recording actual settings and task completion.
acceptanceCases.expected: No loss of content or operation. CSS viewport emulation does not close real zoom acceptance.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: Reflow at narrow CSS width and real zoom
acceptanceCases.procedure: Use320CSSpx width and separately1280window with actual400% zoom; test long labels, DOI and notebook content.
acceptanceCases.expected: No page-level horizontal scrolling; essential2D tables use labeled keyboard-operable local scroll.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: User text spacing
acceptanceCases.procedure: Apply line-height1.5, paragraph margin2em, letter-spacing.12em and word-spacing.16em together, including long controls.
acceptanceCases.expected: No truncation, overlap or loss; fixed-height components do not hide text.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: Reading mode
acceptanceCases.procedure: Toggle reading mode in a long article and the experiment, enter/exit using native controls and repeat at enlarged text.
acceptanceCases.expected: Single-column reading preserves sources, limitations, equations, tables and essential navigation; no duplicate content IDs.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: Languages and equivalent routes
acceptanceCases.procedure: Navigate English/Spanish equivalents and English-only notebook notices; read controls, validation and status messages in their actual language.
acceptanceCases.expected: html lang and substantial fragments accurate; no flag-only or falsely translated page; scientific translation reviewed separately.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: Images figures and data alternatives
acceptanceCases.procedure: Compare every informative image, SVG, scientific diagram and future data plot with its concise alt and structured explanation.
acceptanceCases.expected: Faithful relationships, units, data/uncertainty and purpose; no invented exact values; decorative images properly ignored.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: Scientific tables
acceptanceCases.procedure: Use a real screen reader to navigate table headers/cells at desktop and narrow widths; operate any sorting.
acceptanceCases.expected: Captions and associated headers persist; local scrolling does not destroy semantic relations.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: Structured mathematics
acceptanceCases.procedure: Read and explore notebook MathML using real target AT/browser, compare variables and source LaTeX, inspect for duplicated speech.
acceptanceCases.expected: One usable mathematical representation and explanatory variables. MathML presence alone does not prove speech navigation.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: PDF and download alternatives
acceptanceCases.procedure: Inventory each actual downloadable document; examine source, selectable text, tags, language, order, headings, tables and alternatives.
acceptanceCases.expected: HTML equivalent where appropriate; no inference that export/scan/OCR equals accessible PDF. No fictitious CV file.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: No-JavaScript and blocked resources
acceptanceCases.procedure: Disable JavaScript, block relevant external resources and simulate module/iframe failure on editorial and notebook paths.
acceptanceCases.expected: Essential content/routes stay usable; inactive experiment is explained with disabled controls; no blank page or fake success.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: Reduced data and loading
acceptanceCases.procedure: Enable low data, inspect network requests, delay external services and compare initial versus explicitly requested resources.
acceptanceCases.expected: No automatic media/feed payload; core route works on low data; measured bytes distinguished from proposed budgets.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: Pointer alternatives to dragging
acceptanceCases.procedure: Inventory drag/multipoint interactions; for any future one perform the same task with keyboard AND pointer without dragging.
acceptanceCases.expected: Both alternatives available where needed. No current drag control is invented merely to test this case.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: Touch orientation and target sizes
acceptanceCases.procedure: Use actual touch/landscape, cancellation and keyboard concurrently; measure principal control hit regions at small base fonts.
acceptanceCases.expected: At least44×44CSSpx for project controls; no forced device motion or hidden keyboard support.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: Voice operation and clear instructions
acceptanceCases.procedure: Use real voice-control software to activate visible labels and complete research/contact/experiment actions; ask a reader to follow instructions.
acceptanceCases.expected: Visible names match accessible names; instructions do not require remembering icon/color metaphors; no microphone-only path.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: Tooltip hover/focus behavior
acceptanceCases.procedure: Inventory tooltips or hover/focus overlays; if present test dismissible, hoverable and persistent behavior without moving focus unnecessarily.
acceptanceCases.expected: Essential help is always available. Native click disclosure is not misrepresented as a tooltip.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: Copy citations code and clipboard failure
acceptanceCases.procedure: Copy citation/code/email normally and with denied clipboard API; compare exact selected text and focus.
acceptanceCases.expected: Accurate text, no hidden prompts or line numbers, one status and a selectable fallback on failure.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: Authentication and consequential processes
acceptanceCases.procedure: Inventory authentication, CAPTCHA, personal data and consequential/multistep submissions; test applicable recovery/review/redundant-entry conditions.
acceptanceCases.expected: Current static site has none of these processes; future additions must update scope, not inherit N/A.
acceptanceCases.automaticScope: See site/tests-v2/site.spec.mjs and evidence/v2-browser.json; automated subsets do not replace the manual procedure.

acceptanceCases.title: Help consistency and timing
